h1: Custom Drinkware Design, Logo Printing and OEM/ODM
lead: Customize a listed product with your artwork or develop a new plastic cup shape through OEM/ODM. Our factory team provides free design proposals and product visual mockups.
html:
Choose the level of customization

Start with the base model, then define artwork, product configuration and packing. A different cup shape is a development project, not just a different print file.

Choose a confirmed decoration route

We screen print plastic cups, stadium cups, shot glasses and ice buckets. Silicone cups use UV printing or color-changing ink; ice buckets also support heat transfer decoration. Manual-tool laser work follows the component scope.
